d: High-priority exoplanets and benchmark atmospheres observed by the James Webb Space Telescope.

jwst.x: Premier infrared space observatory orbiting the Sun-Earth L2 Lagrange point, characterizing exoplanet atmospheres and deep-space targets.

lhs-1140-b.x: Benchmark temperate world observed with JWST NIRISS and NIRSpec, revealing signatures consistent with a nitrogen atmosphere and secondary ocean.

trappist-1-e.x: Prime Earth-sized habitable-zone target in the TRAPPIST-1 system subjected to exhaustive atmospheric reconnaissance by JWST NIRSpec and MIRI.

55-cancri-e.x: Ultra-hot super-Earth Janssen observed by JWST NIRCam and MIRI, detecting evidence of a volatile-rich secondary atmosphere outgassed from a magma ocean.

eps-ind-ab.x: Spectacular directly imaged cold Jovian world revealed by JWST MIRI coronagraphy at 10.65 and 15.5 microns.

hr-8799-e.x: Innermost giant planet of the famed HR 8799 four-planet architecture, analyzed with JWST NIRCam and MIRI to determine atmospheric molecular chemistry.

b.s: Flagship exoplanetary science targets observed and characterized by JWST NIRSpec, NIRISS, and MIRI instruments.
b.r: STScI JWST Science Releases & Astrophysical Journal Letters
